design_decisions: publish-readme creates a temp dir containing only README.md, then calls create_github_pr()
NO_CHANGE detection: compare rendered content hash against remote SHA; skip PR if identical
Dry-run: render + audit + simulate (no remote write); live: requires APPROVE_LIVE_PR token
Both Cells and Words need backfill; stub READMEs (40 bytes) must be replaced
PR title: 'Add pipeline-generated README for {display_name} LowCode Examples'
Approval token checked BEFORE any remote write (same as publish-pr pattern)
